verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community thread (comm-13). It reports that Meilisearch's analytics are on by default, sending a daily ping with a unique identifier, and users argued it should be opt-in. That implies an opt-out exists, but the pack never documents it. The analytics docs describe customer-facing search analytics, not product telemetry, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a telemetry opt-out flag or environment variable, a description of what data is collected, a privacy-respecting opt-in default, and hands-on confirmation that disabling it stops the ping.
